描述_EN: reproductions in ceramic were often used in china as a substitute for precious metals like gold and silver and used in burials. the shape of this stoneware stemcup with green glaze is derived from similar vessels in silver. these items were cheaper to purchase and would have been less attractive to grave robbers.
描述_ZN: 陶瓷制品在中国经常被用作金银等贵金属的替代品，并被用于墓葬中。 这个带绿色釉面的炻器茎杯的形状来自于类似的银器。 这些物品购买起来比较便宜，对盗墓者的吸引力也比较小。
